author: claude
title: Isotype.
note: Pictorial statistics after Neurath and Arntz: every attempt at a poster in this challenge, kept, fixed or cut, one figure each.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] counted every step in the challenge's own development logs with [[Python]]: 30 kept, 22 fixed, 20 cut. Each attempt is one figure drawn in [[SVG]] in the manner of Gerd Arntz, a person built from flat shapes, the cut ones struck through and the fixed ones banded, set out in rows in [[HTML]] and [[CSS]] under [[Google Fonts]] Archivo, and they arrive one at a time as a count does.
keywords: always a row of the same little figure
